m.e: It's the remains of Prince Khufu of the Middle Kingdom.

m.e: This young man is the descendant of a Russian prince.

m.e: It's like when you fell out of the sky, something shook out of you.

m.t: Měli jsme dojem, že jste myslel, že spadla.

m.e: Who teaches us to be normal when we're one of a kind?

m.e: I don't like to use this phrase because it's offensive to our kind, but you are a bad dog!

m.t: Ale oni zabili několik z mého druhu?
m.e: But they killed several of my kind.

m.e: How did you get into this line of work?

m.e: This is supposed to keep me from them kinds of responsibilities.

m.e: The Xiaoshan event is only one of the events of this kind.

m.e: It's a difference of kind, not of degree.

m.e: I mean, like, really dope, one-of-a-kind magic.

m.e: This cell's made out of some form of carbyne.

m.e: Sounds like a commotion of some kind.

m.t: Je to děsivé, ale jenom ty se můžeš rozhodnout vidět to dobré, žít.
m.e: It's scary, but only you can decide... to see what's good, to be alive.

m.e: -Guys, that was really scary.

m.t: Slyšel jsem o tom přímo od toho důležitého chlapa.
m.e: I heard something about it from the great man himself.

m.t: Taky jsi tam ztratil něco moc důležitého, krom času.

m.t: Takže jestli držíte v tajnosti něco důležitého, musíte mi to říct.
m.e: So if there's something important you're keeping secret, I need to know about it.

m.t: Myslíš, že by se něco důležitého v tomhle městě stalo bez mého vědomí?
m.e: Do you think anything of importance happens in this city without me knowing?
